gates.name: 독립 리뷰
gates.instructions: Find correctness bugs, security issues, and unmet requirements; report these as blocking. Also report as blocking any UI change that does not use the roles and components in packages/ui/DESIGN.md or bypasses a shared component: styling text or surfaces in a screen instead of using Text, textStyles, Card, or surfaceStyles; re-creating a packages/ui component inside an app; borrowing a token or status color for a meaning it does not have; or silencing the design-system checks (lint overrides, check:lengths exceptions) without a reason in the PR. Then compare the diff against CODING_STANDARDS.md and report each violation as non-blocking, citing the rule title. Apply the standards only to lines the diff adds or changes. Do not comment on style.
